prompt: Build the Chinese internet meme character 大笑奶龙 (Laughing Nailong, also called 奶蛙) in 3D with three.js from memory, as it appears in the meme. No reference image is provided. Task (3D, static, from memory): write an HTML page that builds the character from code and renders it from your reference camera. For this static task, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>大笑奶龙 · Laughing Nailong (奶蛙)</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin:0; padding:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; background:#fdf1d7; }
  canvas { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

/* ============================================================
   大笑奶龙 (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) — built from memory in code.
   Chubby yellow milk-dragon, head thrown back, eyes squeezed
   shut into happy arcs, giant frog-like open laughing mouth.
   ============================================================ */

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias:true, preserveDrawingBuffer:true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240);
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfdf1d7);
scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xfdf1d7, 16, 42);

const ref = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(32, 1, 0.1, 120);
ref.position.set(0.55, 2.10, 7.8);
ref.lookAt(0, 1.72, 0);

/* ---------------- lights (readable from every side) ---------------- */
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff8e8, 0xe0c090, 1.05));

const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.0);
key.position.set(3.5, 7.0, 4.5);
key.castShadow = true;
key.shadow.mapSize.set(1024, 1024);
key.shadow.camera.left = -4.5; key.shadow.camera.right = 4.5;
key.shadow.camera.top = 5.0;   key.shadow.camera.bottom = -2.0;
key.shadow.camera.near = 1;    key.shadow.camera.far = 22;
key.shadow.bias = -0.0003;
key.shadow.normalBias = 0.02;
key.target.position.set(0, 1.3, 0);
scene.add(key, key.target);

const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe8c8, 0.6);
fill.position.set(-4.5, 2.5, 3.0);
scene.add(fill);

const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4dd, 0.9);
rim.position.set(-2.0, 5.0, -6.0);
scene.add(rim);

/* ---------------- toon materials ---------------- */
const gradData = new Uint8Array([115, 166, 217, 255]);
const grad = new THREE.DataTexture(gradData, 4, 1, THREE.RedFormat);
grad.minFilter = grad.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
grad.generateMipmaps = false;
grad.needsUpdate = true;

const toon = (c) => new THREE.MeshToonMaterial({ color:c, gradientMap:grad });
const M = {
  yellow : toon(0xffd23e),
  cream  : toon(0xfff3c9),
  dark   : toon(0x33281e),
  mouth  : toon(0x8e3230),
  throat : toon(0x5f1f1e),
  tongue : toon(0xff8d9a),
  blush  : toon(0xffb59b),
  outline: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color:0x3a2b1c, side:THREE.BackSide })
};

const SPH = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 48, 32);
const Z_AXIS = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);

function ellipsoid(mat, sx, sy, sz, name, withOutline = true) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(SPH, mat);
  m.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
  m.name = name;
  m.castShadow = true;
  if (withOutline) {
    const o = new THREE.Mesh(SPH, M.outline);
    o.scale.setScalar(1.05);
    o.name = name + '-outline';
    o.castShadow = false;
    m.add(o);
  }
  return m;
}

/* group whose +Z points along the sphere normal at pos (unit head space) */
function faceGroup(x, y, z, name) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  g.position.set(x, y, z);
  g.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(Z_AXIS, new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z).normalize());
  return g;
}

/* ---------------- character ---------------- */
const nailong = new THREE.Group();
nailong.name = 'nailong-laughing';
scene.add(nailong);

/* body */
const body = new THREE.Group();
body.name = 'body';
body.position.set(0, 1.02, 0);
nailong.add(body);
const torso = ellipsoid(M.yellow, 0.85, 0.90, 0.79, 'torso');
body.add(torso);
const belly = ellipsoid(M.cream, 0.595, 0.663, 0.527, 'belly', false);
belly.position.set(0, -0.07, 0.33);
belly.castShadow = false;
body.add(belly);

/* tail */
const tail = new THREE.Group();
tail.name = 'tail';
tail.position.set(0, 0.78, -0.82);
tail.rotation.x = 0.45;
nailong.add(tail);
tail.add(ellipsoid(M.yellow, 0.19, 0.19, 0.42, 'tail-tip'));

/* legs / feet */
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const leg = new THREE.Group();
  leg.name = side < 0 ? 'leg-left' : 'leg-right';
  leg.position.set(0.35 * side, 0.15, 0.12);
  nailong.add(leg);
  leg.add(ellipsoid(M.yellow, 0.27, 0.17, 0.38, 'foot'));
}

/* arms raised in laughter */
function buildArm(side) {
  const arm = new THREE.Group();
  arm.name = side < 0 ? 'arm-left' : 'arm-right';
  arm.position.set(0.80 * side, 1.46, 0.02);
  arm.rotation.z = -1.02 * side;
  arm.rotation.x = -0.30;
  nailong.add(arm);

  const upper = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.155, 0.44, 6, 18), M.yellow);
  upper.name = 'arm-capsule';
  upper.position.y = 0.27;
  upper.castShadow = true;
  const ao = new THREE.Mesh(upper.geometry, M.outline);
  ao.scale.setScalar(1.06);
  upper.add(ao);
  arm.add(upper);

  const hand = new THREE.Group();
  hand.name = side < 0 ? 'hand-left' : 'hand-right';
  hand.position.set(0, 0.62, 0);
  arm.add(hand);
  hand.add(ellipsoid(M.yellow, 0.20, 0.21, 0.20, 'palm'));
  const fingerGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.07, 16, 12);
  [[-0.10, 0.16, 0.02], [0, 0.20, 0.03], [0.10, 0.16, 0.02]].forEach((p, i) => {
    const f = new THREE.Mesh(fingerGeo, M.yellow);
    f.name = 'finger-' + i;
    f.position.set(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
    f.castShadow = true;
    hand.add(f);
  });
}
buildArm(-1); buildArm(1);

/* ---------------- head (tilted back, laughing) ---------------- */
const head = new THREE.Group();
head.name = 'head';
head.position.set(0, 2.42, 0.06);
head.rotation.x = -0.20;
head.scale.set(1.07, 0.98, 0.95);
nailong.add(head);

head.add(ellipsoid(M.yellow, 1, 1, 1, 'skull'));

/* little horn nubs */
const horns = new THREE.Group();
horns.name = 'horns';
head.add(horns);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const h = ellipsoid(M.yellow, 0.14, 0.25, 0.14, side < 0 ? 'horn-left' : 'horn-right');
  h.position.set(0.30 * side, 0.94, -0.02);
  h.rotation.z = -0.22 * side;
  horns.add(h);
}

/* eyes squeezed shut: happy ∩ arcs */
const eyes = new THREE.Group();
eyes.name = 'eyes';
head.add(eyes);
const eyeGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.175, 0.052, 12, 36, Math.PI * 0.92);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const g = faceGroup(0.40 * side, 0.20, 0.894, side < 0 ? 'eye-left' : 'eye-right');
  const arc = new THREE.Mesh(eyeGeo, M.dark);
  arc.name = 'eyelid-arc';
  arc.rotation.z = (Math.PI - Math.PI * 0.92) / 2 - 0.10 * side;
  arc.position.z = 0.02;
  g.add(arc);
  eyes.add(g);
}

/* raised brows */
const brows = new THREE.Group();
brows.name = 'brows';
head.add(brows);
const browGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.12, 0.028, 10, 24, Math.PI * 0.60);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const g = faceGroup(0.42 * side, 0.50, 0.757, side < 0 ? 'brow-left' : 'brow-right');
  const b = new THREE.Mesh(browGeo, M.dark);
  b.rotation.z = (Math.PI - Math.PI * 0.60) / 2 - 0.08 * side;
  b.position.z = 0.015;
  g.add(b);
  brows.add(g);
}

/* blush */
const blushG = new THREE.Group();
blushG.name = 'blush';
head.add(blushG);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const g = faceGroup(0.66 * side, -0.12, 0.742, side < 0 ? 'blush-left' : 'blush-right');
  const b = ellipsoid(M.blush, 0.15, 0.09, 0.05, 'blush-patch', false);
  b.castShadow = false;
  b.rotation.z = 0.15 * side;
  g.add(b);
  blushG.add(g);
}

/* tiny nostrils */
const nostrils = new THREE.Group();
nostrils.name = 'nostrils';
head.add(nostrils);
const nosGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.028, 12, 10);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const n = new THREE.Mesh(nosGeo, M.dark);
  n.name = side < 0 ? 'nostril-left' : 'nostril-right';
  n.position.set(0.085 * side, 0.10, 0.992);
  nostrils.add(n);
}

/* giant wide-open laughing mouth (the 奶蛙 grin) */
const mouth = new THREE.Group();
mouth.name = 'mouth';
mouth.position.set(0, -0.30, 0);
head.add(mouth);

const lipLine = ellipsoid(M.dark, 0.70, 0.50, 0.30, 'mouth-outline', false);
lipLine.position.set(0, 0, 0.772);
lipLine.castShadow = false;
mouth.add(lipLine);

const interior = ellipsoid(M.mouth, 0.65, 0.45, 0.30, 'mouth-interior', false);
interior.position.set(0, 0, 0.786);
interior.castShadow = false;
mouth.add(interior);

const throat = ellipsoid(M.throat, 0.45, 0.28, 0.24, 'throat', false);
throat.position.set(0, 0.02, 0.88);
throat.castShadow = false;
mouth.add(throat);

const tongue = ellipsoid(M.tongue, 0.40, 0.18, 0.24, 'tongue', false);
tongue.position.set(0, -0.25, 0.90);
tongue.castShadow = false;
mouth.add(tongue);

/* ---------------- ground ---------------- */
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.CircleGeometry(50, 48),
  new THREE.MeshToonMaterial({ color:0xf3dfb6, gradientMap:grad })
);
ground.name = 'ground';
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
ground.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(ground);

/* ---------------- static render contract ---------------- */
function render(t) {
  /* static pose: t is intentionally ignored; pixels are deterministic */
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref },
  characters: [nailong],
  render,
  ready: true
};

render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
